findings: Anonymous map_anon uses MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANON and READ|WRITE, fd=-1,offset0; requested byte length is independently bounded to4MiB before syscall.
All Cell fields are integers; repr(C),8byte size and4byte alignment. Pod derive rejects padding and non-Pod fields at compile time; no manual unsafe trait implementation.
bytemuck mutable cast checks alignment and length division, with NoUninit+AnyBitPattern on both types; immutable cast checks the same bounds.
Builder borrows the map exclusively while copying; make_read_only consumes its only mutable owner and applies PROT_READ before publication. Failure drops unpublished mapping.
Published CellPage is behind Arc with no mutable-access API. Row ranges are checked before storage and cannot change; returned slices borrow owner lifetime.
Mapped cell mutation first allocates owned Vec with remembered capacity and copies; it never writes mapped memory or changes another capture.
MmapInner Drop munmaps only after final Arc owner is gone. No madvise,decommit or remap is called.
Existing active Row struct remains112bytes on measured target; original capacities,charge fields and encoded metadata are preserved.
